reference_prolog:
% Case facts
petitioner_nationality(nigeria).
last_entry_december_2016.
filed_i360_july_2021.
married_to_jmt_january_2019.
jmt_is_us_citizen.

% Prior marriages facts
prior_marriage_one(m_e_r, november_2009, november_2016, nigeria).
prior_marriage_two(b_s_j, january_2019, divorced, texas).
final_decree_divorce_for_second_marriage.    % Texas final decree provided for second marriage

% Evidence submitted regarding termination of first marriage
has_customary_judgment.                      % Petitioner submitted a Customary Court Judgment dated 2016
judgment_date_2016.
judgment_contains_typo_regfistrar.          % Typographical misspelling noted: "REGFISTRAR"
judgment_signature_irregularities.           % Adjudicator perceived irregularities in signature block
judgment_format_appearance_irregular.        % Document appearance differs from other Nigerian divorce documents
jurisdiction_disputed.                       % The petitioner contested a jurisdiction issue raised in adjudication

% Administrative record of procedural steps
rfe_requested_additional_proof.              % USCIS issued a Request for Evidence for termination proof
responded_to_rfe_with_same_document.         % Petitioner responded with the same Judgment and additional documents
appeal_submitted_brief_and_additional_evidence.
appeal_evidence_includes_letter.             % June 2023 letter from Local Government Grade "A" Customary Court
appeal_evidence_includes_marriage_act_copy.  % Copy of The Marriage Act submitted on appeal
appeal_evidence_includes_affidavit.          % Affidavit from I-E- submitted on appeal

% Legal-requirement predicates (arity 0 or 0-arity rules)
% Spouse of U.S. citizen (requires proof of marriage to a U.S. citizen)
spouse_of_us_citizen :-
    married_to_jmt_january_2019,
    jmt_is_us_citizen.

% Good-faith entry into the marriage (petitioner asserts good faith marriage;
% no record in facts that this was discredited)
entered_marriage_in_good_faith.

% Petitioner must have been battered or subjected to extreme cruelty: facts do not
% establish such evidence in the record supplied here, so predicate fails.
battered_or_extreme_cruelty :-
    fail.

% Immediate-relative eligibility (married to a U.S. citizen) - treated as satisfied here
immediate_relative_eligibility :-
    spouse_of_us_citizen.

% Credibility evaluation of the Customary Court Judgment
judgment_credibility_undermined :-
    judgment_contains_typo_regfistrar;
    judgment_signature_irregularities;
    judgment_format_appearance_irregular;
    jurisdiction_disputed.

credible_customary_judgment :-
    has_customary_judgment,
    \+ judgment_credibility_undermined.

% Corroboration from appeal submissions (letter + affidavit + statutory citation)
% In this record the petitioner submitted additional materials on appeal, but there
% is no unquestioned primary, official corroboration (for example, a certified
% official court record or other primary official proof) that overcomes the documented
% undermining factors. Therefore we do not treat the appeal materials as
% independently sufficient to establish a credible termination for the prior marriage.
corroboration_sufficient :-
    fail.

% Proof that all prior marriages of the petitioner were terminated before the qualifying marriage.
% This is required by regulation. The petitioner provided:
% - a Customary Court Judgment (has_customary_judgment) that is undermined per the record,
% - and appeal materials that do not constitute undisputed primary corroboration (corroboration_sufficient fails).
% He did provide a final decree for the second marriage, but the dispositive issue here is
% termination of the first (Nigerian) marriage to M-E-R- before he married J-M-T-.
proof_termination_all_prior_marriages :-
    % success conditions (none are met in this factual record):
    (   final_decree_divorce_for_first_and_second -> true
    ;   credible_customary_judgment -> true
    ;   corroboration_sufficient -> true
    ),
    !.
% Explicitly fail if none of the success conditions are met.
proof_termination_all_prior_marriages :-
    fail.

% The eligibility predicate requires all statutory/regulatory elements.
eligibility_met :-
    spouse_of_us_citizen,
    entered_marriage_in_good_faith,
    battered_or_extreme_cruelty,
    immediate_relative_eligibility,
    proof_termination_all_prior_marriages.

% Decision and runtime harness (provided structure)
decision(Result) :-
    (   eligibility_met
    ->  Result = 'Accepted'
    ;   Result = 'Dismissed'
    ).

run :-
    catch(
        (   decision(Result),
            writeln(Result)
        ),
        error(existence_error(procedure, PI), _),
        handle_undefined(PI)
    ).

handle_undefined(Name/Arity) :-
    (   current_predicate(Name/OtherArity),
        OtherArity \= Arity
    ->  format('Programming error: called ~w/~w, but only ~w/~w is defined.~n',
               [Name, Arity, Name, OtherArity])
    ;   format('Lack of information: predicate ~w/~w is not defined.~n',
               [Name, Arity])
    ).

expected.question: Should this case be accepted or dismissed?
